entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, I need to make a return for an order I placed a little while back.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. I can certainly help you with that. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Mark Rivera, order number VF-881-2099.

Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up your order now... I see the Ascent Pro Jersey, delivered on December 7th. What specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's a preference thing. I ordered my usual size, but this specific jersey is just too tight across the shoulders. It's the wrong size for this particular cut, I guess. I'd like to either return it or do an exchange if possible.
I understand completely. Getting the perfect fit is key. Let me just check the policy for you. One moment.

Okay, thanks for holding, Mark. I see the jersey was delivered 56 days ago. Our standard apparel items have a 90-day return window, so you are well within the timeframe. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.

That's great news, thank you, Diana. I appreciate how easy that was. Now, since I do have to package this up and send it back, and I'm planning to place a new order for the right size, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase? Just to offset the hassle.

I understand you're looking for a discount, Mark. While I can't provide a credit for a standard size-related return, I can process this return for a full refund to your original payment method. Or, if you prefer, I can help you set up an exchange for the correct size right now to make that process smoother for you.
Alright, I thought I'd ask. An exchange sounds good, actually. Let's do that. Can we do one size up in the same color?

Of course. I've just initiated the exchange process. You'll receive an email shortly with a pre-paid return label to send back the jersey that was too tight. As soon as the carrier scans your return package, we'll ship out the new size to you. Does that work?
Yes, that's perfect. Thanks for your help today.
You're very welcome, Mark. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's all. Have a good day.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
